sections.title: باب 3 — متن (174)

paras.text: Von Kremer writes about Islamic fiqh that "After the Romans, the Arabs or Muslims are the only nation who can take pride in their treasure of law."

paras.text: In medicine and pharmacy the Muslims of Andalus attained a very high position. They invented medicines from various herbs and discovered the treatments of many fatal diseases. For medicine regular universities were established and degrees were given for becoming a physician. Regular laboratories and experimental centres were built. When plague spread in Europe, Ibn al-Khatib for the first time presented the theory of diseases spreading through contagion. Physicians and scholars like Razi, Tabari and Bu Ali Sina were born. Tabari wrote the book "al-Mu'alajah", and Zakariya al-Razi wrote "al-Hawi" and the book "al-Judari wa al-Hasbah". In this very era the beginning of joining wounds with stitches was made by Muslims.

paras.text: In chemistry Jabir bin Hayyan attained the greatest fame in this era. He is also called the inventor of chemistry. Jabir bin Hayyan prepared acid first of all. He was the inventor of alcohol, sulphur, making steel and other chemical products …

حکمت و سائنس کی طرح فلسفہ بھی اس دور کے اہم علوم میں شامل تھا۔ الکندی، فارابی، بوعلی سینا اس دور کے مشہور فلسفی تھے۔ اسکندری حکیمِ عرب کہلاتا تھا۔ فارابی کو اپنے زمانے کا ارسطو اور معلمِ ثانی کہا جاتا ہے۔ بوعلی سینا فارابی کے شاگرد تھے۔ ان فلسفیوں سے مشرق و مغرب ہر علاقے کے لوگ متاثر ہیں۔ ابوبکر محمد بن یحییٰ ابن باجہ بارہویں صدی کا عظیم فلسفی تصور کیا جاتا تھا۔ ابن رشد نے علمِ فلسفہ میں عظیم مقام حاصل کیا مگر اس کے کچھ نظریات و افکار اسلامی تعلیمات سے متصادم تھے۔

اسی دور میں ایک معروف بزرگ الکرخی نے علمِ تصوف میں خوب شہرت حاصل کی۔ اسی طرح ایک اور معروف بزرگ فلسفی ابو محمد کو ان کے علم کی وجہ سے قطب الدین کا لقب دیا گیا۔ انہوں نے تصوف کے موضوع پر کتاب ”اسرار الحکمت“ لکھی جو تصوف کی اعلیٰ تصنیف سمجھی جاتی ہے۔

سائنسی علوم

اندلس کے دورِ حکومت کو سائنس کا اسلامی دور کہا جاتا ہے۔ اس دور میں نہ صرف یونانیوں کے علمی ذخیرے کو عربی زبان میں تبدیل کیا گیا بلکہ سائنس اور اس کے فروغ میں بھی مسلمانوں نے اپنا لوہا منوایا۔ سائنسی علوم میں علمِ طب، علمِ کیمیا، علمِ ریاضی، علمِ طبیعات، علمِ فلکیات، علم التاریخ اور علمِ جغرافیہ نمایاں ہیں۔

علمِ طب اور دوا سازی میں اندلس کے مسلمانوں نے بہت اعلیٰ مقام حاصل کیا۔ مختلف جڑی بوٹیوں سے ادویات ایجاد کیں اور بہت سی مہلک بیماریوں کے علاج دریافت کیے۔ علمِ طب کے لیے باقاعدہ یونیورسٹیاں قائم تھیں اور طبیب بننے کے لیے اسناد دی جاتی تھیں۔ باقاعدہ لیبارٹریاں اور تجربہ گاہیں بنائی گئیں۔ یورپ میں جب طاعون پھیلا تو ابن الخطیب نے پہلی دفعہ چھوت کے ذریعے امراض پھیلنے کا نظریہ پیش کیا۔ رازی، طبری، بوعلی سینا جیسے طبیب اور عالم پیدا ہوئے۔ طبری نے کتاب ”المعالجہ“ لکھی، زکریا الرازی نے ”الحاوی“ اور کتاب ”الجدری والحصبۃ“ لکھی۔ اسی دور میں زخموں کو ٹانکوں سے جوڑنے کا آغاز مسلمانوں نے کیا۔

علمِ کیمیا میں جابر بن حیان کو اس دور میں سب سے زیادہ شہرت حاصل ہوئی۔ اسے علم کیمیا کا موجد بھی کہا جاتا ہے۔ جابر بن حیان نے سب سے پہلے تیزاب تیار کیا۔ وہ الکوحل، گندھک، فولاد بنانا اور دیگر کیمیائی مصنوعات کا موجد

sections.content:
Von Kremer writes about Islamic fiqh that "After the Romans, the Arabs or Muslims are the only nation who can take pride in their treasure of law."

Like wisdom and science, philosophy too was included among the important sciences of this era. Al-Kindi, al-Farabi and Bu Ali Sina were famous philosophers of this era. Iskandari was called the Hakim of the Arabs. Al-Farabi is called the Aristotle of his age and the Second Teacher. Bu Ali Sina was a student of al-Farabi. From these philosophers the people of every region of the East and the West are influenced. Abu Bakr Muhammad bin Yahya Ibn Bajjah was considered the great philosopher of the twelfth century. Ibn Rushd attained a great position in philosophy, but some of his theories and thoughts clashed with Islamic teachings.

In this era a well-known saint, al-Karkhi, attained great fame in tasawwuf. In the same way another well-known saint-philosopher, Abu Muhammad, was given the title Qutb al-Din because of his knowledge. He wrote the book "Asrar al-Hikmah" on the topic of tasawwuf, which is considered a high work of tasawwuf.

Scientific sciences

The era of rule of Andalus is called the Islamic era of science. In this era not only was the academic treasure of the Greeks transferred into the Arabic language, but Muslims also made their mettle felt in science and its promotion. Among the scientific sciences, medicine, chemistry, mathematics, physics, astronomy, history and geography are prominent.

In medicine and pharmacy the Muslims of Andalus attained a very high position. They invented medicines from various herbs and discovered the treatments of many fatal diseases. For medicine regular universities were established and degrees were given for becoming a physician. Regular laboratories and experimental centres were built. When plague spread in Europe, Ibn al-Khatib for the first time presented the theory of diseases spreading through contagion. Physicians and scholars like Razi, Tabari and Bu Ali Sina were born. Tabari wrote the book "al-Mu'alajah", and Zakariya al-Razi wrote "al-Hawi" and the book "al-Judari wa al-Hasbah". In this very era the beginning of joining wounds with stitches was made by Muslims.

In chemistry Jabir bin Hayyan attained the greatest fame in this era. He is also called the inventor of chemistry. Jabir bin Hayyan prepared acid first of all. He was the inventor of alcohol, sulphur, making steel and other chemical products …

sections.title: باب 3 — متن (175)

paras.text: … was. He wrote many books on chemistry, in which discussion exists about various chemical processes, experiments and chemical apparatus. Besides him, Muhammad bin Zakariya al-Razi, Abu al-Qasim Majriti and al-Kathi were experts of chemistry.
paras.urdu: ہے۔ اس نے علم کیمیا پر بہت سی کتب تحریر کیں جن میں مختلف کیمیاوی عملوں، تجربوں اور کیمیائی آلات کے بارے میں بحث موجود ہے۔ اس کے علاوہ محمد بن زکریا الرازی، ابو القاسم، مجریطی اور الکاثی علم کیمیا کے ماہرین تھے۔
paras.pashto: … و. هغه پر کیمیا ډېر کتابونه ولیکل، چې په هغو کې د بېلابېلو کیمیاوي عملیو، تجربو او کیمیاوي آلو په اړه بحث شته. سربېره پر دې محمد بن زکریا الرازي، ابو القاسم مجریطي او الکاثي د کیمیا ماهران وو.

paras.text: After transferring the academic treasure from the Greeks into Arabic in 'ilm al-hay'ah and mathematics, the Muslim scientists of Andalus made great progress in these sciences. They divided mathematics into algebra, geometry and handasah (geometry). Al-Khwarizmi for the first time used zero and numerals. His famous work is "al-Mukhtasar fi Hisab al-Jabr wa al-Muqabalah". A long list of the experts of mathematics of this era can be made. The European nations are benefiting till today from the laws made in this very era. In astronomy and hay'ah Muslims accomplished valuable services. Theories like the lunar eclipse, the solar eclipse, the distance of planets and stars, and the rainbow were for the first time brought forth correctly in this very era. Among Muslim experts of astronomy at that time were Nawbakht, Muhammad bin Musa al-Khwarizmi, 'Umar Khayyam, Ibn Yunus, Ahmad Sijistani, Abbas Ibn Ba'd Jawhari etc. The clock, calendar, telescope, and the measurement of the circumference of the globe etc. are inventions of this very era.
paras.urdu: علمِ ہیئت اور علم الریاضی میں یونانیوں سے علمی ذخیرہ عربی میں منتقل کرنے کے بعد اندلس کے مسلمان سائنسدانوں نے ان علوم میں بھی خوب ترقی کی۔ ریاضی کو الجبرا، جیومیٹری، ہندسہ میں تقسیم کیا۔ الخوارزمی نے صفر اور ہندسوں کا پہلی دفعہ استعمال کیا۔ اس کی مشہور تصنیف المختصر فی الحساب الجبر والمقابلہ ہے۔ اس دور کے ریاضی کے ماہرین کی ایک لمبی فہرست بنائی جا سکتی ہے۔ یورپی اقوام اسی دور کے بنائے گئے قوانین سے آج تک استفادہ کر رہے ہیں۔ علمِ فلکیات اور ہیئت میں مسلمانوں نے گرانقدر خدمات سرانجام دیں۔ چاند گرہن، سورج گرہن، سیاروں اور ستاروں کا فاصلہ، قوسِ قزح جیسے نظریات کو پہلی دفعہ اسی دور میں صحیح طرح سامنے لایا گیا۔ مسلمان ماہرینِ فلکیات میں اس وقت نوبخت، محمد بن موسیٰ الخوارزمی، عمر خیام، ابن یونس، احمد بجستانی، عباس ابن بعد جوہری وغیرہ تھے۔ گھڑی، کیلنڈر، دوربین، کرۂ زمین کے گھیراؤ کی پیمائش، وغیرہ اسی دور کی ایجادات ہیں۔

After transferring the academic treasure from the Greeks into Arabic in 'ilm al-hay'ah and mathematics, the Muslim scientists of Andalus made great progress in these sciences. They divided mathematics into algebra, geometry and handasah (geometry). Al-Khwarizmi for the first time used zero and numerals. His famous work is "al-Mukhtasar fi Hisab al-Jabr wa al-Muqabalah". A long list of the experts of mathematics of this era can be made. The European nations are benefiting till today from the laws made in this very era. In astronomy and hay'ah Muslims accomplished valuable services. Theories like the lunar eclipse, the solar eclipse, the distance of planets and stars, and the rainbow were for the first time brought forth correctly in this very era. Among Muslim experts of astronomy at that time were Nawbakht, Muhammad bin Musa al-Khwarizmi, 'Umar Khayyam, Ibn Yunus, Ahmad Sijistani, Abbas Ibn Ba'd Jawhari etc. The clock, calendar, telescope, and the measurement of the circumference of the globe etc. are inventions of this very era.

After transferring the academic treasure from the Greeks into Arabic in 'ilm al-hay'ah and mathematics, the Muslim scientists of Andalus made great progress in these sciences. They divided mathematics into algebra, geometry and handasah (geometry). Al-Khwarizmi for the first time used zero and numerals. His famous work is "al-Mukhtasar fi Hisab al-Jabr wa al-Muqabalah". A long list of the experts of mathematics of this era can be made. The European nations are benefiting till today from the laws made in this very era. In astronomy and hay'ah Muslims accomplished valuable services. Theories like the lunar eclipse, the solar eclipse, the distance of planets and stars, and the rainbow were for the first time brought forth correctly in this very era. Among Muslim experts of astronomy at that time were Nawbakht, Muhammad bin Musa al-Khwarizmi, 'Umar Khayyam, Ibn Yunus, Ahmad Sijistani, Abbas Ibn Ba'd Jawhari etc. The clock, calendar, telescope, and the measurement of the circumference of the globe etc. are inventions of this very era.

Ibn al-Haytham was an expert scientist of physics. He worked on sight, light and many important topics. His famous works consist of theories of light and vision. Besides him, among the famous scholars of physics of this era come Bu Ali Sina, Ya'qub Kindi, Ahmad bin Musa etc.

The renowned scholar and historian of the science of history was "Ibn Qutiyyah". Living in Cordoba he wrote its history, which is called "Iftitah al-Andalus". Among the famous names of this era in history-writing were Ibn Khaldun, Ibn Hayyan, Ibn al-Khatib and Ibn 'Asakir etc.

Muslim scholars travelled to many regions. They did not ignore geography. The people of Europe kept using the knowledge of Muslim geographers as an authority for three hundred years. The greatest geographer of the eleventh century is Abu 'Ubaydah bin Abd al-Aziz al-Bakri. His work "al-Masalik wa al-Mamalik" is very famous. Muslims corrected many theories of the Greeks related to geography.
